approved_payload.content: Cause of death unknown. Police opened an inquest, not a murder case. A 53-year-old man who lived alone was found dead, his body partly decomposed, in a shack at his home in Madombidzha village, about 13 km south-west of Louis Trichardt, on 1 October. A friend who went to check on him found him; he had last been seen alive on 26 September (his aunt, via Limpopo Mirror, 8 October). Vhembe police spokesperson Captain Vuledzani Dathi said Tshilwavhusiku police opened an inquest docket. The family suspects foul play and believes he may have been killed elsewhere and his body left in the shack; that is the family's belief, not a police finding. No cause of death, post-mortem result, murder case or arrest has been reported. When he died is not known, and it may have been before 1 October. The man is not named here. One account, repeated: Review Online (19 October) carries the same reporting. The pin is approximate (village level). This pin is checked in every three-day collection run and will be updated if police confirm a cause of death or open a case.
